## The study

- 300 adults with raised blood pressure at four Midwest clinics
- Randomized to a lifestyle **intervention** or usual-care **control**
- Up to four visits a year apart: blood pressure, weight, labs
- One survey on sleep, exercise, stress, and satisfaction

Every week's code reads the same database through the `study` connection in
`settings.yml`.

## Who enrolled

```{r}
enrolment <- db_query(
  "SELECT s.site_name, s.setting, p.treatment, COUNT(*) AS n
   FROM participants p JOIN sites s ON s.site_id = p.site_id
   GROUP BY s.site_name, s.setting, p.treatment",
  "study"
)
enrolment |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = n) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Visits thin out

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
visits_per_arm <- db_query(
  "SELECT p.treatment, v.visit_number, COUNT(*) AS n
   FROM visits v JOIN participants p ON p.participant_id = v.participant_id
   GROUP BY p.treatment, v.visit_number",
  "study"
)
ggplot(visits_per_arm, aes(visit_number, n, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Visit", y = "Participants seen", fill = NULL)
```

Fewer than 60% of participants reach visit 4. Keep that in mind when you
compare later visits.
